learnings: `sqlite3` with `?` placeholders makes SQL injection impossible – the unsafe f-string version leaks every row.
`with conn:` wraps statements in a transaction: all succeed or everything rolls back.
`PRAGMA user_version` gives simple, ordered schema migrations without an ORM.
pitfalls: Foreign keys are off by default in SQLite – enable `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` on every connection.
